text:
A super simple workflow for cinematic 3D logo reveal videos:

Your Image → Custom GPT Image 2.0 Storyboard → Seedance 2.0

I created a Custom GPT that helps you turn a simple brand name or logo idea into a complete 3D logo reveal workflow.

Here’s how it works:

You give only your brand name or logo text.
The GPT researches the best visual direction.
It creates a premium 3D logo concept.
It asks 10 smart questions with recommendations.
After confirmation, it generates 3 refined logo image options.
You choose one image.
The GPT writes a max 12 second Seedance 2.0 cinematic logo reveal prompt.
You use the generated logo image as a reference in Seedance 2.0.

This is made for creators who want a clean, simple, and repeatable workflow for high quality logo reveal animations.

My Created Custom GPT link: https://t.co/MpYp3yc9BT 

Buy me a coffee link: https://t.co/5GtHqvtJNp

Try it and let me know what you create.
content:
Use a workflow of Your Image → Custom GPT Image 2.0 Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 to create cinematic 3D logo reveal videos.  
Have a Custom GPT generate a max 12-second Seedance 2.0 cinematic logo reveal prompt based on your chosen logo concept.  
Use the generated logo image as a reference image in Seedance 2.0 to guide the logo reveal animation.
